messages:
leah: Quick kickoff for launch funnel SEO + webinar routing. Need checklist for keywords, schema, internal links, redirect rules, and final CTA anchors. Can someone take the canonical mapping?

arjun: I got canonical mapping. Plan: map each intent to a single landing URL, set 301s from legacy posts, preserve query params for UTM, and keep the register flow crawlable. I'll share a CSV.

marta: I'll own schema and structured data. We should include Event schema for the webinar, FAQ for the benchmark post, and BreadcrumbList on the landing page. Will prepare snippets for CMS insertion.

carlos: Analytics notes: use distinct utm_term values for keyword groups and tag CTAs with `cta=register|bench|kit`. Also mark the thank-you pages `noindex`. We'll instrument GA4 event names: `cta_click`, `register_submit`, `lead_complete`.

arjun: For redirects: prefer single-hop 301s. Example rules (nginx):
```
# migrate old article to new launch lp
rewrite ^/articles/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# prefer direct 301s rather than chaining
```
I'll flag any temporary experiment redirects as 302.

marta: Schema snippet I'll add: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood: Scaling Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
Also adding FAQ `mainEntity` arrays for the benchmark piece.

leah: Internal linking plan: add 2 contextual links from product docs and 3 from the benchmark post to the main landing. Use short anchor text: "Register", "Read the benchmark", "Get the starter kit". Avoid linking to thank-you pages.

carlos: One more for redirects: ensure canonical tags on the landing point to the canonical URL even if query params differ. Also run link equity check post-301s.

arjun: Will run staging crawl after CMS deploy and report back on redirect chains and status codes. If any 3xx chains >1, we'll flatten.

marta: Please ensure the benchmark post has `FAQPage` schema with the top 6 Qs. That helps SERP features.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for branch `marketing/webinar-funnel` - preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-2026-preview. Running staging crawl and Lighthouse.
